author: Dampyr
quote: Can't ask for anything else, it is the original game but much better. Super smooth, graphics are great, richer dialogue, ect. It made me feel like a happy kid again.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Dampyr
quote: Not was I was expecting. 30fps cap is crazy in 2026. The "being a good boyfriend" simulation... omg, really bad start plus so many bugs. I know that having high expectations for a game that has been in the works for over a decade can play tricks on you, but still, very dissapointing.
